description: Generate a new image from a text prompt using AI (Grok Imagine). Paid tool - billed per call via the agent payment rails (x402/L402); not covered by any free quota. Generation runs asynchronously on the server and this call polls until it completes, up to ~90 seconds. If you get a "still running" error, call the tool again with the SAME payment proof to resume polling - you will never be charged twice for one payment. Note for x402 clients: "quality" mode (~$0.15) exceeds the agents-SDK default per-call cap of $0.10 - raise maxPaymentValue in withX402Client to use it.

mode.description: Generation quality tier - "standard" (default, cheaper) or "quality" (higher fidelity, costs more).

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate (max 2000 characters).

name: generate_meme

outputSchema.description: The AI-generated image produced by a paid generate_meme call.

image_url.description: Direct serve URL for the full generated image bytes.

tags.description: Scored tags assigned to the generated image.

thumbnail_url.description: Thumbnail URL for the generated image.

url.description: MemeStack gallery page URL for the generated image.
